integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the location-scale transformation, density, identifiability proposition, threshold profiling, analytic rate profiling, and the one-dimensional scale profile likelihood. General parameter-dependent-support literature was checked for broader coverage. The scale-collapse theorem was independently derived from the displayed likelihood and replayed with a standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the unconstrained three-parameter location-scale extension, not the original one-parameter MERD inference.
It establishes MLE nonexistence but does not select a unique constrained, penalized, or Bayesian replacement.
The all-equal sample is excluded; under the continuous model it has probability zero for sample size at least two.
title: The three-parameter MERD likelihood is unbounded under scale collapse
